newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia auctions bills, bonds on Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: Russia auctions bills, bonds on Sept 18.

text.p: The finance ministry will auction 7.50 trillion roubles of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills and 2.00 trillion roubles in a new tranche of the two-year OFZ interest-bearing bond maturing in March 1998, the central bank said on Wednesday.
Full details of the auctions follow.
Note - the T-bills are classified as six-month paper although the actual tenor is just over seven months.
Details of the OFZ bond tranche
The bond pays its next quarterly coupon on December 11. The coupon has been set at 149,788 roubles, equivalent to an annual rate of 60.08 percent, less accruals of 11,522.15 roubles.
On Tuesday, the bond closed at 85.25.
There are no limits on purchases of the bills or bonds by non-residents.
On September 18, the finance ministry will also repay about 6.00 trillion roubles in maturing six-month bills (series 22025).
